messages:
nina: FYI ran a quick smoke after onboarding refresh. node sample-app retried a POST after 429 and doubled an order in staging.

harry: did it include an Idempotency-Key?

nina: no, sample-apps still show naive retries. node SDK also ignored Retry-After and did linear sleep.

leah: parity gap. python reads Retry-After and uses exp+jitter; node uses fixed waits.

harry: proposal: change SDK defaults to (1) honor Retry-After if present, (2) otherwise exponential backoff with full jitter, base 200ms cap 10s, max attempts 5, (3) classify 429 as throttling by default.

nina: also add client option `safeReplay` (default false) and helper `withIdempotencyKey()` for sample apps. onboarding docs should call these out explicitly.

leah: agree. small server note: document idempotency key TTLs per endpoint (payments 24h, create-user 1h).

devex-bot: created ticket DEVEX-1042 "sdk: 429 parity, jitter defaults, idempotency in samples" assigned to @harry and @nina. :spiral_note_pad:
